items.title: Syrian authorities reopen 841 km of roads in war-hit Aleppo
items.source_excerpt: Syrian authorities have initiated the "Echo of Resilience 2" project, removing barriers and reopening 841 kilometers of roads in Aleppo's countryside to restore access to farmland and boost economic activity after years of civil war. This effort, supported by the Ministry of Emergency and Disaster Management and the Ministry of Defense, spans 255 cities and villages, allowing farmers easier access to their fields and improving connectivity in the region.
